g.text: Purpose: placeholder-quality 2D-flavored top-down sprite set for
up), barricade plug (96x48, intact + broken), ground tile (128x128,
dark, subtle noise), wall segment (128x64). Style: flat, readable
silhouettes, muted palette (dark slate ground, cyan player,
orange/purple/red enemies); outline 2 px. Format: PNG with
transparency, 1x scale (no packing required), no anti-aliased halo
on outlines. Constraints: no photorealism, no text baked in;
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
